title: Percent field: a display key that shows a plain percentage instead of the progress bar, in list cells and on the record page
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27430 (rows 2–4) said: TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `ed0e71db` (report 6515939841, `out_of_scope_findings`). Row 2 is taken in PR #27972.
Reach: any `percent` field that is a rate or a probability rather than progress: HotCRM `crm_opportunity.probability` and the campaign rate fields (#27430 row 3).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the key; `Clause-②: yes`, widening; `Metadata-protocol` added), then `domain:ui` (the renderer reads it).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "percent field progress bar plain percentage display PercentCellRenderer" → #5066 only (closed; chip clipping, a different gap).

## Observed
`PercentCellRenderer` (`ui/packages/fields`) draws a progress bar for every percent value, with no key to turn it off. It is the face that list-grid cells and the record page's percent fields (`DetailView`, `HeaderHighlight` chips) share. Nothing existing selects a plain face:
- `Field.format` has no declared vocabulary and only promotes textual types.
- `Field.widget` is the form override.
- `ListColumn.type` is a renderer override whose number face would print the stored fraction (0.25), not 25%.

## Wanted
A declared display key on the field (and optionally on the list column), for example a percent display mode, with the bar as the default. The spec half: the key, its describe text and docs. The ui half (a follow-up `domain:ui` card once the key ships): `PercentCellRenderer` reads it on every host. Note that `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` is held today by `domain:ui` seat 4's PR #27912.

Dedupe words: percent progress bar, percent display, plain percentage, probability bar, PercentCellRenderer.

Related: #27430 (row 3), #5066.
